source: Verified research, Devin Local 3000.14.30833 (Windsurf / Devin Desktop) entry: bundled docs extensibility/hooks/overview.mdx and lifecycle-hooks.mdx, changelog/stable.mdx (skeptic: hook_pre_tool and hook_stop corrected, hook_session_start confirmed).

sniff.source: Devin hook_pre_tool: DEVIN_PROJECT_DIR is set for hooks; the Claude-format payload adds prompt_id (overview.mdx lines 111-121), and the skeptic adds tool_provenance.

selection.bareNote: The Devin payload is Claude-shaped. Whether Devin honours the Claude hookSpecificOutput deny is not in the verified research, so a Devin run relies on --agent devin or the DEVIN_PROJECT_DIR sniff.

deny.source: Devin hook_payload_example: exit 0 and print {decision: block, reason} (overview.mdx line 53).

context.source: Devin hook_session_start (skeptic: confirmed): hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext on stdout (lifecycle-hooks.mdx line 286).
